<thought>Based on the exact mass (127.0997 Da) the molecular formula is C7H13NO. The 13C NMR shows a carbonyl carbon (~161 ppm) and two sp² carbons (~144 and 130 ppm), indicating an α,β‑unsaturated amide. The remaining aliphatic carbons (19–27 ppm) correspond to two ethyl groups on the nitrogen. This matches N,N‑diethylacrylamide, whose SMILES is “CCN(CC)C(=O)C=C”. The SMILES is valid and fits all spectral data.</thought>
<final_answer>CCN(CC)C(=O)C=C</final_answer>
